ios.desc:
Drop strokes without expensive lessons. Swing Sensei scores your swing out of 10 and shows you exactly what to fix — in seconds, on your iPhone.

And with Live Range Mode, put your phone on a tripod at the driving range and get spoken feedback after every single swing — like having a coach standing behind you, for the price of a sleeve of balls.

Developed with Matt Montecucco, PGA — Junior Program Coordinator at Chambers Bay, host of the 2015 U.S. Open. Used by 60,000+ golfers. 100% on-device. No uploads. No internet required.

WHAT YOU GET
- Sensei Score out of 10, with detailed feedback on 11 checkpoints — from hip hinge at address to posture at impact
- Live Range Mode: real-time voice coaching at the range, every swing scored and saved automatically
- Cause-and-effect coaching that explains what's wrong, why it matters, and how to fix it
- A PGA-pro drill video for every major fault, filmed by Matt at Chambers Bay
- Your Week in Review every Sunday: your trend, your best swing, and the #1 thing to work on
- Per-checkpoint trend charts, slow-motion playback (0.25x / 0.5x / 1x), and still frames at all 6 swing phases
- Weekly streaks built for real golf schedules — one session a week keeps it alive
- Friends, leaderboards, and shareable score cards
- Full support for left-handed golfers

HOW IT WORKS
1. Film or import a down-the-line swing — or start a live range session
2. Sensei analyzes every checkpoint in seconds
3. Get your score and a personalized fix for your weakest area

WHY SWING SENSEI IS DIFFERENT
Most AI golf apps upload your video to a cloud server. Swing Sensei does everything on your phone with on-device AI:
- No uploads, ever — your video never leaves your device
- Works at the range, on the course, anywhere — no signal required
- Results in seconds
- Privacy by design: we never see your swings, your scores, or your data. We can't.

PRICING
Free: 3 swing analyses per month. Subscription and lifetime options in the app.

Stop guessing what's wrong with your swing. Start fixing it.

Built by Colin Tam at UCLA. Drill content by Matt Montecucco, PGA — Junior Program Coordinator at Chambers Bay (host of the 2015 U.S. Open Championship).
